summary.headline: Astrological Questions on Theft
summary.text: Catalog entries 254–274 for a Greek astrological codex, covering interrogations about accusations, journeys, lost objects, dreams, high priests and rulers, treasures, theft, and the thief’s identity, body, origin, kinship, knowledge, whereabouts, and the source of stolen goods. Cross-references to Codex 6 and folios 66, 66v, 110v–114 are given, along with an astrolabe procedure for finding the degree of the eleventh place.
